title: MRF Plant Manager
text:
MRF Plant Manager

*Emterra Environmental USA | Lansing Material Recovery Facility*

**Location**

Lansing, Michigan

 

**Reports to**

Process Improvement Manager

 

**Employment type**

Full-time, salaried

 

**Compensation**

$90,000 - $100,000 plus 10% discretionary bonus

**About Emterra**
-----------------

Every day, Emterra Environmental USA helps communities recover resources, reduce waste and create a cleaner future. For 15 years we have partnered with Michigan communities, businesses and municipalities to deliver reliable waste and recycling services. What began as Emterra Group's first expansion into the U.S. has grown into a team of 215 employees serving 75 communities across the state.

**The Opportunity**
-------------------

We are looking for an experienced MRF Plant Manager to run day-to-day operations at our Lansing Material Recovery Facility. You will manage and coordinate production, logistics and maintenance, keep the plant compliant with all safety, environmental, labor and corporate requirements, and hold profit and loss (P&L) responsibility for setting and achieving the facility's budget and production targets. You will also play a key role in plant improvements and special projects.

**What You Will Do**
--------------------

* Supervise, coordinate and schedule plant staff and key operational personnel so the facility runs safely and efficiently.
* Optimize the processing of incoming recyclable material shift to shift, based on current intake volumes.
* Maximize daily production and uptime, increase productivity, minimize residue, audit inbound and outbound material, and produce commodities that meet buyer quality specifications.
* Own the plant's internal reporting, including daily bale counts, facility inspections, pre- and post-trip reports, daily MRF statistics and audit reports.
* Understand and monitor the flow of material through the system, and act proactively on suggestions and corrective actions to maximize throughput.
* Maintain maintenance calendars and logbooks for plant and mobile equipment.
* Have mechanical aptitude to ensure the daily trouble shooting and maintenance of the lines and to provide guidance to the maintenance team.
* Develop and manage the facility budget and production targets, and report on cost, throughput and commodity performance.
* Know and comply with all local, state and federal requirements for the facility and its operating permits and registrations, including MIOSHA and OSHA workplace safety standards and Michigan Department of Environment, Great Lakes, and Energy (EGLE) requirements.
* Protect the health and safety of every worker by making all workers aware of known hazards and ensuring they are trained on all applicable equipment, processes and duties.
* Lead plant improvement and special projects, and work closely with Collections, Sales, Maintenance, Safety and Finance teams.

**What You Bring**
------------------

* 5+ years of experience in a Material Recovery Facility (MRF), recycling, manufacturing or production environment, including 5 + years supervising a team production planning experience.
* Strong knowledge of maintaining the processing equipment (conveyors, screens, optical sorters, balers) and the mechanical processes with material flow.
* Working knowledge of MIOSHA/OSHA safety standards, including lockout/tagout, and of environmental compliance for a solid waste or recycling facility.
* Comfortable with data, reporting and Microsoft Office; experience with maintenance or production tracking software.
* A clear communicator and hands-on leader who can coach a team, hold people accountable and drive continuous improvement.
* Willingness to work flexible hours, including early mornings, or evenings or weekends as plant needs require.
* Post secondary diploma or degree in a related field in operations, engineering, or business management.

**Why Emterra**
---------------

* Stable, year-round work in an essential service.
* Competitive salary and benefits package: medical, dental, vision, 401(k).
* A supportive team that backs you on the plant floor and across the business.
* The chance to make a real difference in your community and the environment.
* Growth opportunities with a company that has been investing in Michigan for 15 years.

**How to Apply**
----------------

Apply online at emterrausa.com/pages/careers or send to hr.us @emterrausa.com. We thank all applicants for their interest; only those selected for an interview will be contacted.

*Emterra Environmental USA is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, height, weight, marital status or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local law. Reasonable accommodations are available on request throughout the hiring process.*
